cash_tip: People reported the Kapital Bank ATM in town had cash on Thursday afternoon, so start there, and always pick 'decline conversion' so you're charged in pesos. It's Sunday and machines can run dry before they're restocked, so take out enough in one go and keep small bills for tacos, taxis and the market.
